# Evaluation report (generated by eval/make_report.py)

n = 45 real receipts, scored against hand labels in `eval/labels.json`. A row is **correct** when vendor, date, total AND line-item sum all match the label.

## 0. v1 (clean, before any fix) versus v2 (after four fixes made while looking at v1 errors)

v1 is the honest out-of-the-box number. v2 fixed: injection regex scanning the model's own notes; strict tax-inclusive flag; unpriced line items; scoring of unpriced lines. The fixes were chosen after seeing errors on these same 45 receipts, so v2 is optimistic. No model call changed between v1 and v2 except a handful of extra re-reads.

| config | row correct v1 | row correct v2 | flagged v1 | flagged v2 | silent errors v1 | silent errors v2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| single:claude-haiku-4-5 | 76% | 80% | 45 | 45 | 0 | 0 |
| single:claude-haiku-5-5 | 96% | 98% | 45 | 45 | 0 | 0 |
| single:claude-sonnet-5-5 | 98% | 100% | 45 | 45 | 0 | 0 |
| single:claude-opus-5-5 | 98% | 100% | 45 | 45 | 0 | 0 |
| dual:claude-haiku-4-5 | 78% | 82% | 10 | 9 | 4 | 4 |
| dual:claude-haiku-5-5 | 96% | 98% | 10 | 7 | 1 | 1 |
| dual:claude-sonnet-5-5 | 100% | 100% | 2 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| dual:claude-opus-5-5 | 98% | 100% | 4 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| mixed:sonnet+haiku55 | 98% | 100% | 5 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| mixed:haiku55+sonnet | 96% | 98% | 6 | 4 | 0 | 0 |

## 2. Can a human trust the flags? (the metrics that decide the design)

`silent errors` = wrong rows that were marked **OK** (the dangerous kind). `error catch rate` = share of wrong rows that got flagged. `false alarm rate` = share of correct rows flagged anyway (wasted review time). `AUROC` = chance a correct row has higher confidence than a wrong one (0.5 = coin flip, 1.0 = perfect).

| config | rows OK / flagged | OK-row precision | silent errors | wrong rows | error catch rate | false alarm rate | flag rate | AUROC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| single:claude-haiku-5-5 | 0 / 45 | n/a | **0** | 1 | 100% | 100% (98% excl. duplicate flag) | 100% | 0.50 |

| single:claude-opus-5-5 | 0 / 45 | n/a | **0** | 0 | n/a | 100% (98% excl. duplicate flag) | 100% | n/a |
| dual:claude-haiku-4-5 | 36 / 9 | 89% | **4** | 8 | 50% | 14% (11% excl. duplicate flag) | 20% | 0.74 |
| dual:claude-haiku-5-5 | 38 / 7 | 97% | **1** | 1 | 0% | 16% (14% excl. duplicate flag) | 16% | 0.26 |
